title: Easy Garlic Pasta

ingredients.item: Chopped parsley or other fresh herb

steps: Pasta. Cook the pasta in salted water; keep some pasta water.*
Garlic oil. Gently cook the sliced garlic and anchovies in the olive oil until the anchovies melt and the garlic is golden.*
Emulsify. Add the pasta with a splash of pasta water, the butter and lemon juice; toss until glossy.*
Finish. Toss with parsley and Parmesan, then top with toasted breadcrumbs.*
notes: * The post lists only ingredients; the method is written from the listed ingredients and the reel, with no quantities added.
